messages:
nora: Heads-up — two customers reported duplicate side-effects from the onboarding sample when a 429 happens right as auth refresh completes.
diego: yep that's the classic refresh+immediate-replay race. did we get logs?
tara: shared a minimal sanitized trace: 
```
2026-02-25T08:12:01Z auth: refresh:start
2026-02-25T08:12:01Z api: 429 rate_limit route=/v1/createSession
2026-02-25T08:12:01Z auth: refresh:done
2026-02-25T08:12:01Z client: replaying original request immediately
2026-02-25T08:12:01Z api: session created id=sess_01
2026-02-25T08:12:01Z api: session created id=sess_02
```
tara: both created within ~60ms. painful because onboarding sample shows naive wrapper and customers copy it.
diego: immediate mitigation suggestions:
- sample app: always add Idempotency-Key for write endpoints in examples
- SDK: when replaying after auth refresh, add a small randomized delay (jitter) before replay
- telemetry: emit a `replay_after_refresh` tag so we can measure prevalence
nora: agree. also suggest an SDK configuration: `replayMode: 'compat'|'jittered'|'strict'`. default `jittered` to avoid breaking users.
tara: for strict mode, SDK should refuse to replay non-idempotent calls unless an Idempotency-Key is present and log a clear error.
diego: small code snippet for sample app docs: 
```
// on refresh path
if (authRefreshed) {
  await sleep(Math.floor(Math.random() * 180) + 20) // 20-200ms jitter
}
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = headers['Idempotency-Key'] || uuidv4()
```
nora: +1. Also add a short explanation in onboarding: "Why jitter helps — reduces collision window when server-side dedupe isn't available".
tara: infra note: if services can support best-effort dedupe within ~250ms, that helps, but can't rely on it universally.
diego: operationally, add a structured log field `replay_suspect=true` and a metric `sdk.replays_after_refresh` so SRE can create an alert if it spikes.
nora: SDK PR plan: implement `replayMode` config, default jittered behavior, telemetry tag, and a unit test that simulates 429+refresh race asserting only one create when Idempotency-Key is present and at most one when jittered.
tara: QA: i'll add an e2e test to sampleapp that simulates token expiry + 429 storm and asserts single side-effect. ci-bot: created ticket DX-362500 "onboarding dup side-effect: refresh race".
ops-bot: ticket DX-362500 created and assigned to devex-team.
diego: one subtlety — streaming / long-poll endpoints shouldn't auto-insert idempotency keys. docs should call out streaming vs request/response differences.
nora: good point. add callout in docs and sample app: only auto-key non-stream writes when user opts in.
tara: final ask: add a short troubleshooting section: how to tell if duplicates are from refresh-replay vs other causes (look for `replay_suspect` logs, timestamps within ~300ms, missing idempotency header).
diego: no objections. i'll open SDK PR after sampleapp patch.
nora: thanks everyone. moving this into a small epic and will follow up with PR links. :thumbsup:
